messages:
liam: quick heads-up — ran a cross-region bring-up for neox-20b q8_0 (int8) on A100 clusters across us-east / us-west / eu-west. did 1k requests, seq=128, batch=1. noticed eu-west p95 is much higher and jitter is worse.

maria: can you paste the perf numbers + exact runtime image?

liam: pasted numbers below (local run, same workload):

```
region    p50(ms)  p95(ms)  throughput(tok/s)  kernel
us-east   52       110      13000             optimized_int8_kernel_v2
us-west   58       140      12500             optimized_int8_kernel_v2
eu-west   85       235      9800              fallback_fp16_kernel
```

liam: root cause looks like kernel selection fallback in eu-west — nodes there have an older driver/image combo that lacks the fused int8 gemm we rely on, so the runtime picks the fp16 path. also observed KV cache cold rate ~18% higher in eu-west which amplifies p95.

zhang: ok — which image & driver versions? sounds like a mismatch.

liam: image: inference-runtime:2025-03-11-cu12, expected driver >=540. eu-west nodes are on driver 535. validation log snippet: `kernel_select: no_int8_fused_gemm -> using fp16_path`. full trace: https://internal/redwood/traces/abcd (access-controlled).

sam: suggestion: temporarily route latency-sensitive traffic away from eu-west (A/B) until infra can upgrade drivers. also enable aggressive prefix caching for eu-west hot routes to reduce KV cold misses.

maria: capacity note — with current fallback kernel eu-west needs ~+20% GPU headroom to meet same p95. if infra upgrades drivers so int8 path is available we project p95 drop ~80-100ms.

infra-bot: scheduled: eu-west driver upgrade canary window reserved at 1851238600. automated healthchecks will run post-upgrade.

oliver: also flagging eng-runtime: we should add an explicit kernel-compat check in onboarding to avoid silent fallback. and track quality delta: q8_0 vs fp16 fallback may shift token probs — run eval pairs.

liam: proposed next steps:
1) infra: schedule and run the canary upgrade (infra-bot already scheduled)
2) eng-runtime: add kernel compatibility assertion + logging so we surface fallback reasons in telemetry
3) devex/ops: apply a routing override for 48h to prefer us-east/us-west for this model while we validate
4) research: run 5k-request QA for int8 kernel in eu-west post-upgrade and compare p50/p95 + throughput + token-level evals

maria: +1
sam: i'll open the routing PR and add the cache tweak, will link shortly.

liam: thanks — i'll collect the perf artifacts and attach to the postmortem board once we have canary results.
